question: Which offices may read analytics, topic maps, single-source flags and event notes derived from exit interviews classified privileged, legal_sensitive or executive_confidential, and must such interviews be excluded from, or redacted in, the aggregates that a steward or officer reads?
decision: Privileged, legal_sensitive and executive_confidential source interviews must not contribute to lower-floor reports, graphs, timelines or inference outputs. Admin-level reports may include them only if each interview permits that purpose and the reader has a separate authorized mandate. Apply anti-reidentification suppression to restricted aggregates.
originalProposedDecision: Privileged, legal_sensitive and executive_confidential interviews are excluded from steward and officer aggregates and the governance timeline; only admins see aggregates that include them.
independentApprovalScope: decision wording / platform baseline only; NOT independent security or operational testing
